list.title: Invoices
list.description: Customer invoices and credit memos — your accounts receivable: draft → approval → posted through the kernel.
list.emptyDescription: Enter the first customer invoice or credit memo to start the AR workflow.

drawer.deleteDraftBody: This permanently deletes the draft. This cannot be undone.
drawer.deletePostedBody: This permanently deletes the document and removes its ledger impact. This cannot be undone.
drawer.formPreferredFailed: Could not save the preferred form

cockpit.title: Accounts Receivable
cockpit.description: Your receivables control center — what you're owed, what's overdue, and what to collect this week.
cockpit.noReceivables: No open receivables. Everything is collected.
cockpit.configDescription: How the worklist is ordered and collection dates are predicted. Read-only — collections have no cap; the engine predicts when customers pay.

panels.scheduleHint: Predicted collections over {weeks} weeks — click a week

worklist.empty: No collections predicted in the horizon.

model.title: How collections are predicted

worklistOrder.label: Worklist order
worklistOrder.note: The chase list sorts by days overdue, then largest amount — overdue invoices come pre-selected

prediction.label: Collection-date prediction
prediction.note: Per-customer average collection days (+½σ buffer), floored at the due date

overduePush.label: Overdue push
overduePush.note: Overdue invoices move forward based on how overdue they are (≤30 / ≤60 / >60 days)

businessDay.label: Business-day adjustment
businessDay.note: Predicted weekend dates move to the next business day

dso.label: Average days to collect (DSO)
dso.note: Fallback used when a customer has no payment history

model.recurring: Recurring inflows (grants, rent received, subscriptions) join the forecast as categories — configure them in the <cashCockpit>Cash cockpit</cashCockpit>.
